the-twist.title: The twist
the-twist.keywords: AI can help you onboard AI, the context you forgot, first morning
the-twist.script: But here is the twist. AI can help you onboard AI. It can interview you for the context you forgot, and ask the questions a good new colleague would ask on their first morning.

a-first-step.title: A first step

a-first-step.script: If you want a first step, there is a simple one called grill-me, which does exactly that. Try it on your next real task. And that is all you need to start.
